title: Zesty Crunchy Norwegian Saskatoon Berries Salad
description: A spicy, crunchy salad packed with sashimi-sliced Saskatoon berries, toasted walnuts and a zesty dressing—perfect for low‑sodium meal prep.
instructions: Slice the Saskatoon berries into thin, sashimi‑like slices and place them in a bowl.
Toss the mixed salad greens, diced cucumber, and toasted walnuts together.
In a small bowl whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, sriracha, black pepper, and chopped dill until emulsified.
Pour the dressing over the salad mixture and toss until evenly coated.
Sprinkle the crumbled low‑sodium feta over the top and gently fold it in.
Add the sliced berries back onto the salad, arranging them in a fan shape for visual appeal.
If using yogurt, drizzle it in a zig‑zag pattern across the salad for creaminess.
Serve immediately or chill in the fridge for up to 24 hours before serving.
